name: sprout-ctd
description: Sprout is a financial literacy demo app designed for Code the Dream Summer Practicum 2026. It is a full-stack learning app to help us learn how to work together on a project together.
author: DanyloHet,kwishart24,berenicerojas,BytesOfStrength,mnichols08

scripts.setup: npm i && cd backend && npm i && cd ../frontend && npm i
scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently --kill-others --no-handle-signal "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
